description: Plan v7 section 8.3 zero-boundary clause: maximumCompactExponent is non-negative and zero builds. PluralOperands.Builder.build treats an unset compact exponent as an effective 0, so at this limit both an absent and an explicit zero exponent resolve while exponent 1 is rejected by DefaultStrings.validatePluralOperands — not by the operands builder, whose own limit is still the default 64.
